Own verdict: Northstar failed full-outcome closure; production capability remains unproven, usefulness plausible, sellability unknown. Opportunities ranked: 1 prevent goal substitution; 2 sustain delivery through release blockers; 3 validate real-world usefulness/demand.
Gemini review: Agree premature closure is demonstrated, not hypothetical. Accept owner-intent reconciliation, but reject literal immutability: authorized requirements can change. A matched cohort remains proposed evidence, not proof.
Next: 1 Patch existing commander/GOAL/QA: reconcile owner requirements against evidence, blockers and authorized changes; slices remain partial. 2 Replay observed failure: closure must fail with unmet requirements; full completion requires all requirements evidenced. 3 Run matched real-project trials, including release, user acceptance and cost/endurance; assess demand separately.
Risk: Stop adding synthetic probes/prose; require owner scope, access, release authority and market-validation inputs; preserve repository boundaries and unrelated changes.
